patterns.note: Content is presented in a narrow, centered column, visually framed by repeating illustrative figures that act as a decorative border.
A highly decorative, almost calligraphic serif font is used for the main page title, contrasting with a more traditional, readable serif for body text and subheadings.
A muted, earthy palette of off-white, dark brown, and subtle grey tones dominates, with a single vibrant green used sparingly for calls to action.

As the user scrolls, a single line of illustrative figures at the bottom of the hero section transforms into a vertically repeating pattern, forming a continuous border around the central content column.
Each major content section is a long-form text block, introduced by a bold, thought-provoking question or statement, and visually separated by the repeating illustrative figure border.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, decorative title that scrolls off-screen with the page content. Below this, a line of small illustrative figures transitions into a repeating background pattern that frames the central content column as the user scrolls down the page, creating a continuous visual border.

Text content is presented in a single, narrow column with generous line spacing and paragraph breaks, enhancing readability for long-form articles. Subheadings use a slightly larger, bolder version of the body font to introduce new conceptual blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, decorative display heading (~4-5x body) with generous line height, body text is a comfortable reading size, and subheadings are slightly larger and bolder than body.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (for input fields, buttons, and article cards).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, particularly in the hero and between major text blocks, creating a sense of calm and allowing content to breathe.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the clever use of small, illustrative figures that transition from a single line to a repeating, framing border as the user scrolls. This creates a unique visual rhythm and a subtle narrative element, making the long-form content feel more engaging and less overwhelming than a typical text-heavy page.
